articles.title: Brief Russia-Ukraine truce facilitates evacuations from and aid deliveries to Oleshky
articles.description: Russian and Ukrainian officials have entered the devastated city of Oleshky on the fourth day of the most significant truce since Moscow's full-scale invasion 4½ years ago. A convoy including 25 buses, ambulances and aid supplies arrived to deliver food and medicine and evacuate residents who want to leave. Officials from both countries worked together in the rare joint humanitarian effort, offering a brief bright spot in a grim war of attrition. The ceasefire is expected to continue through Sunday evening. A Ukrainian official said residents wishing to leave Oleshky have started to board buses. Both countries say those who remain will continue to receive aid.

articles.title: Ukrainian lawmaker says some residents have been evacuated from the war-ravaged city of Oleshky
articles.description: A Ukrainian lawmaker says some residents of Russian-occupied Oleshky have been evacuated from the war-ravaged city. The evacuations Friday came on the fourth day of the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of neighboring Ukraine began 4½ years ago. Davyd Arakhamia says the evacuees are traveling by bus to the city of Anapa in southern Russia then will flying to Belarus and cross the border into northern Ukraine. Arakhamia is a lawmaker with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s Servant of the People party. A convoy of 25 buses and some ambulances arrived in the Russian-occupied city earlier Friday to deliver food and medicine and evacuate residents.

articles.title: A rare Russia-Ukraine truce allows a humanitarian mission to reach the stricken city of Oleshky
articles.description: Russian and Ukrainian officials have entered the devastated city of Oleshky following a rare ceasefire. The operation, led by Yana Lantratova from Russia and Ukraine’s Dmytro Lubinets, began after demining local roads. Lantratova said people willing to leave are boarding buses, while those staying will receive aid. A humanitarian convoy, including 25 buses and ambulances, has been set up in a nearby town. The mission aims to ensure aid reaches everyone in need, with special attention to the elderly and people with disabilities. The ceasefire and aid mission were brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump.

articles.title: Rubio hosts G20 ministers as Iran, Ukraine wars divide members
articles.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will host his G20 counterparts, including Russia's Sergei Lavrov, for talks on Friday that are expected to be fractious, with wars in Ukraine and Iran and surging energy prices fanning discord. The foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, Georgia, taking place just days before crucial US midterm elections, will set the stage for a December G20 leaders' summit in Miami at President Donald Trump's Doral resort.
